description: [Corporate Council on Africa] New York -- Côte d'Ivoire will take center stage in the U.S.-Africa business relationship in 2027, as Corporate Council on Africa (CCA) today announced that the Republic of Côte d'Ivoire will host the 2027 U.S.-Africa Business Summit.
title: Africa: Corporate Council on Africa Announces Côte d'Ivoire as Host of 2027 U.S.-Africa Business Summit

description: [Nile Post] Africa has attracted $3.1 billion in clean-cooking commitments since the International Energy Agency's inaugural Clean Cooking Summit in 2024. But as billions of dollars flow into the sector, the critical question is no longer simply how much money has been committed it is whether that money is reaching households and delivering sustained access to cleaner cooking.
title: Africa: Follow the Money - Is Africa's $3.1b Clean Cooking Boom Reaching Households?

description: [Reporter] The African Union (AU) Commission has issued an urgent call for de-escalation in the Red Sea region, expressing grave concern over attacks targeting regional economic infrastructure and ongoing threats to international commercial shipping through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
title: Africa: AU Demands Red Sea De-Escalation, Warning Houthi Strikes Threaten Littoral Economies, Global Trade

description: [IFJ] The Steering Committee meeting, which was held from 17 - 18 September, assessed attacks on media freedom, violations of journalists' labour rights and the growing economic pressures facing journalists and news media organisations. Members examined conditions in specific countries and regions, stressing the need for concrete action to defend journalists' rights and safeguard journalism.
title: Africa: African Journalists Leaders Rally for Stronger Collective Action

description: [allAfrica] Geneva -- United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has told the Global Africa Business Initiative that Africa represents a $3 trillion market opportunity and the world is finally recognizing it as a ''gamechanger for global business''.
title: Africa: World Recognizing Africa as a 'Gamechanger for Global Business' - UN Chief

description: [New Times] About 130 Heads of State and government from across the world will gather in New York, USA, from September 22 to 28 to discuss major global issues and set out their positions on matters ranging from peace and security to climate, health and development.
title: Africa: What to Know Ahead of UN General Assembly

description: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- The Chairperson of the African Union Commission, Mahmoud Ali Youssouf, and United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres have co-chaired a high-level AU-UN meeting on the margins of the 81st United Nations General Assembly to deepen strategic cooperation, strengthen peace and security frameworks, and advance global financial reforms in support of Africa.
title: Africa: AU, UN Reinforce Joint Commitments On Peace, Economy and Resource Equity

description: [Shabelle] New York -- African Union Commission Chairperson Mahmoud Ali Youssouf and U.N. Secretary-General Antonio Guterres co-chaired a high-level meeting between the African Union and the United Nations in New York focused on strengthening cooperation between the two organizations.
title: Africa: AU, UN Chiefs Discuss Strengthening Cooperation On Africa's Challenges

description: [Daba Finance] JPMorgan will launch a new benchmark for frontier-market local-currency government bonds by the end of September, giving African debt markets the largest regional weight. The GBI-EM Edge will track about $328 billion across 425 bonds in 26 countries and 24 currencies. African markets will account for about 44.5% of the index, compared with 31.5% for Asia.
title: Africa: Africa to Account for 45% of JPMorgan's New Frontier Market Bond Index

description: [Daba Finance] Airtel Africa is considering cutting the size of Airtel Money's planned London initial public offering after feedback from investors, as the mobile payments business moves closer to a listing that could start as soon as next week. The company is now seeking to raise at least $800 million, below an earlier target of $1.5 billion to $2 billion, Bloomberg reported.
title: Africa: Airtel Money Weighs Smaller London IPO After Investor Feedback

description: [RFI] An Iranian woman expelled to the Central African Republic; a gay Ghanaian man sent back to his country and threatened with death. Their stories are part of a vast international investigation into the Trump administration's mass deportations.
title: Africa: Forbidden Stories' Deportation Project - Exiled to Africa By the U.S.

description: [Independent (Kampala)] Africa is pouring money into pharmaceutical manufacturing as governments seek to reduce dependence on imported medicines. The bigger challenge may be finding enough buyers to keep the factories running.
title: Africa: Africa Is Building Drug Factories - Now It Needs Enough Buyers

description: [Leadership] Nigeria's nine scheduled airlines failed to make Africa's top 10 in the 2026 Skytrax World Airline Awards, as high operating costs and weak passenger demand continue to strain the ability of domestic carriers to sustain operations and expand their networks.
title: Africa: High Costs, Weak Demand Keep Nigerian Airlines Out of Africa's Top 10

description: [Nile Post] Uganda's Permanent Representative to the African Union and the United Nations Economic Commission for Africa (ECA), Ambassador Rebecca Amuge Otengo, has called for sustained follow-up on financing for development and the implementation of the Sevilla commitments.
title: Africa: Uganda Calls for Stronger Follow-Up On Africa's Development Financing

description: [SNA] Khartoum, (SUNA) - Federal Health Ministry officials on Sunday met with a delegation from the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC), an organ of the African Union, during an opening meeting for the delegation's program held at the National Medical Supplies Fund in Khartoum. The meeting brought together Minister of Health Dr. Haitham Mohamed Ibrahim and Ministry Undersecretary Dr. Ali Babiker Sid Ahmed with the delegation, led by East Africa Regional Director Dric Loul.
title: Africa: High-Level Africa CDC Delegation Visits Sudan for First Time in Seven Years

description: [UN News] Compare two children born in the same year: one in a country with functioning schools, social services, fair elections and a dynamic economy and the other in a nation devastated by poverty, conflict, climate change or corruption.
title: Africa: The Right to Development - Why Equity, Not Charity, Is a Human Right

description: [RFI] Europe's maize crops have been hit hard by this summer's heatwaves and ongoing drought, with French producers saying almost half of this year's harvest is unusable. To prepare for hotter, drier conditions, some cereal farmers are experimenting with sorghum - a crop from sub-Saharan Africa that requires less water than maize - although making a living from it remains a long way off.
title: Africa: French Cereal Farmers Experiment With African Sorghum to Beat the Heat

description: [UN News] Six years after COVID-19 killed millions, battered health systems, disrupted lives and brought the global economy to a virtual standstill, the world is still grappling with how we can prepare better for the next pandemic.
title: Africa: The Race to Build a Pandemic-Proof World

description: [UN News] More than eight decades on, the UN General Assembly remains the place where the UN's 193 Member States come together to debate the defining challenges of the day, from war and peace - to development, climate change and human rights.
title: Africa: Why the UN General Assembly Still Matters

description: [UN News] Sitting in her Vienna office ahead of a pivotal UN gathering in Abu Dhabi, Monica Juma is focused on a simple reality: crime has evolved faster than many of the institutions designed to combat it.
title: Africa: UN Crime Congress - Technology Is Transforming Crime - and the Response to It
